implementedTerms.runtimeMapping: WGSL luminance() uses Rec.709 linear coefficients for material lift, cheap-red guard, and display contrast.
Directional key light is separated from hemisphere/floor/ceiling/side fill instead of a flat ambient-only model.
Shader uses a room-space SH/probe proxy with floor bounce, ceiling wash, wall gradient, and side fill.
Robot material kinds receive a stronger view rim and dark-material readability lift.
Ground-height and normal-orientation proxy darkens contact zones without a shadow map pass.
Material-kind roughness controls a compact GGX-like half-vector specular layer.
Cheap red guard suppresses excess red unless the material is explicitly a warning/locked-state material.
Filmic tone mapping, color contrast, and manual sRGB display transform replace raw linear output.
The geometry stream adds two floats per vertex for materialKind and roughness; instance stream adds four floats for raw GPU animation meta.

deferredTerms.reason: Needs room occluder or BVH/light visibility buffer before it can be evaluated per pixel.
Requires a raw texture atlas/material table path instead of current vertex-color material semantics.
Enemy GLBs use rigid node clips with no skins; full reproduction needs a node-palette animation compiler instead of flattened static geometry.

recommendedNextBreakthrough: Compile enemy GLBs into rigid node palettes and animation clips, then evaluate node matrices on CPU or compute and bind the palette as a storage buffer.
